excerpt.zh:
最近在[Root.GetName]上安装的轴基挂载武器对舰船前部结构造成的压力远超最初预期。工程检查发现，从挂载部主要锚点向外延伸的应力裂纹已扩散至周围的船体装甲板。

在损伤得到解决之前，方舟舰的结构强度无法安全支持高速机动。因此，航行部门已实施严格的速度限制，以防止裂纹进一步扩大。

我们可以尝试进行快速现场维修以稳固受损部位，或者指派一艘后勤船进行全面的结构大修。

texts.zh:
最近在[Root.GetName]上安装的轴基挂载武器对舰船前部结构造成的压力远超最初预期。工程检查发现，从挂载部主要锚点向外延伸的应力裂纹已扩散至周围的船体装甲板。

在损伤得到解决之前，方舟舰的结构强度无法安全支持高速机动。因此，航行部门已实施严格的速度限制，以防止裂纹进一步扩大。

我们可以尝试进行快速现场维修以稳固受损部位，或者指派一艘后勤船进行全面的结构大修。
texts.en:
The recently installed Spinal Mount aboard [Root.GetName] has placed greater strain on the vessel's forward structure than originally anticipated. Engineering inspections have uncovered a network of stress fractures radiating from the mount's primary anchor points, spreading across the surrounding hull plating.

Until the damage is addressed, the Arkship's structural integrity cannot safely support high-velocity maneuvering. Navigation has therefore imposed severe speed restrictions to prevent the fractures from widening.

We may attempt rapid field repairs to stabilize the damage, or assign a Logistics Ship to conduct a full structural overhaul.

label.en: Stabilize the fractures and move on.

label.zh: 我们要妥善处理这个情况。

texts.zh:
方舟舰的轴基挂载武器安装工作已导致舰船前部体产生危险的结构应力。

我们将派遣一艘后勤船，全面加固受影响的区域。
texts.en:
The installation of the Arkship's Spinal Mount has introduced dangerous structural stresses along the vessel's forward hull.

A Logistics Ship will be dispatched to fully reinforce the affected sections.

texts.zh:
[event_target:fractured_spine_arkship.GetName]的轴基挂载武器修复工作已经完成。虽然维修过程需要精细的作业和长时间的检查，但我们借此机会加固了舰体多处薄弱部位，并改良了挂架的结构支撑。

这些改进提升了方舟舰在高难度机动时的稳定性，使得导航部门得以解除此前的航行限制。初步测试表明，该舰现在的性能表现比受损前更加出色。
texts.en:
Repairs to the Spinal Mount of [event_target:fractured_spine_arkship.GetName] have been completed. Though the process required careful work and extended inspections, we used the opportunity to reinforce several vulnerable sections of the hull and refine the mount's structural supports.

The resulting improvements have increased the Arkship's stability during high-speed maneuvers, allowing navigation to lift previous restrictions. Early tests suggest the vessel now performs more efficiently than before the damage occurred.
